response.sql: WITH kept AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, t.bandusagepct FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1), profile_stats AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM kept GROUP BY weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_avg FROM profile_stats) SELECT p.weathprofile, p.avg_bandusage, p.telescope_count, p.avg_bandusage - o.mean_avg AS deviation_from_mean FROM profile_stats p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_avg IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with a NULL weathprofile (from a matching observatory) form their own group rather than being dropped.
Telescopes with a NULL detecttempk are excluded, since they cannot satisfy detecttempk >= 152.1.
The telescope count includes telescopes whose bandusagepct is NULL; only the average ignores NULL bandusagepct values.
The mean of per-profile averages is unweighted, and a profile whose average is NULL (all its bandusagepct values are NULL) is excluded from that mean.
If the mean of per-profile averages is NULL (no qualifying profile has a non-NULL average), the query returns no rows.

alternatives.interpretation: Drop telescopes whose observatory has a NULL weathprofile, so no NULL-weather-profile group appears in the output.
alternatives.sql: WITH kept AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, t.bandusagepct FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 AND o.weathprofile IS NOT NULL), profile_stats AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM kept GROUP BY weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_avg FROM profile_stats) SELECT p.weathprofile, p.avg_bandusage, p.telescope_count, p.avg_bandusage - o.mean_avg AS deviation_from_mean FROM profile_stats p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_avg IS NOT NULL;
